cases.question: German AX-17 guidance before latest revision?
cases.answer:
Part 1
Historical view: documents in effect on 2026-09-14.

The superseded German AX-17 guidance, in effect from 03-Feb-2025 to 15-Sep-2026, specified historical starting doses for renal impairment of 50 mg OD for normal, 50 mg OD for mild, 50 mg OD for moderate, and not recommended for severe [E1, E2].

Sources
[E1] DE-AX17-LBL-038 · DE AX17 Superseded Label v3.8 · SUPERSEDED · effective 2025-02-03 · p.6, Historical renal dosing
     https://storage.cloud.google.com/tredence-fde-1-medevidence-vks/raw/DE_AX17_Superseded_Label_v3.8.pdf#page=6
[E2] DE-AX17-LBL-038 · DE AX17 Superseded Label v3.8 · SUPERSEDED · effective 2025-02-03 · p.1–3
     https://storage.cloud.google.com/tredence-fde-1-medevidence-vks/raw/DE_AX17_Superseded_Label_v3.8.pdf#page=1

Current version: DE-AX17-LBL-042 (DE AX17 Current Label v4.2), in effect since 2026-09-15. Ask for the current guidance to see it.

Part 2
Current German AX-17 guidance includes a temporary hepatic monitoring enhancement requiring baseline hepatic laboratory values with repeat testing between Day 14 and Day 21 [E1]. Hepatic monitoring action thresholds are ALT/AST >3x ULN requiring medical review, Bilirubin >2x ULN requiring urgent review, and mild isolated change below trigger requiring a repeat test [E2]. Renal dose modifications are: Normal (eGFR >=90) with a starting dose of 50 mg OD, maximum of 100 mg/day, and routine monitoring [E4]; Mild (eGFR 60-89) with a starting dose of 50 mg OD, maximum of 100 mg/day, and routine monitoring [E4]; Moderate (eGFR 30-59) with a starting dose of 25 mg OD, maximum of 50 mg/day, and monitoring to Recheck 2-4 weeks [E3, E4]; and Severe (eGFR 15-29) with specialist review starting dose, maximum of 25 mg/day, and enhanced monitoring [E4].

Sources
[E1] SB-AX17-2026-09 · SB AX17 2026 09 Safety Bulletin v1.0 · APPROVED · effective 2026-10-07 · section: HelixNova Safety Bulletin SB-AX17-2026-09
     https://storage.cloud.google.com/tredence-fde-1-medevidence-vks/raw/SB_AX17_2026_09_Safety_Bulletin.docx
[E2] SB-AX17-2026-09 · SB AX17 2026 09 Safety Bulletin v1.0 · APPROVED · effective 2026-10-07 · section: HelixNova Safety Bulletin SB-AX17-2026-09 › 4. Safety Evidence and Operational Guidance, Signal / Threshold / Action / Authority
     https://storage.cloud.google.com/tredence-fde-1-medevidence-vks/raw/SB_AX17_2026_09_Safety_Bulletin.docx
[E3] DE-AX17-LBL-042 · DE AX17 Current Label v4.2 · APPROVED · effective 2026-09-15 · p.1
     https://storage.cloud.google.com/tredence-fde-1-medevidence-vks/raw/DE_AX17_Current_Label_v4.2.pdf#page=1
[E4] DE-AX17-LBL-042 · DE AX17 Current Label v4.2 · APPROVED · effective 2026-09-15 · p.6, Table 3
     https://storage.cloud.google.com/tredence-fde-1-medevidence-vks/raw/DE_AX17_Current_Label_v4.2.pdf#page=6

Earlier version: DE-AX17-LBL-038 (DE AX17 Superseded Label v3.8), superseded on 2026-09-15. Ask for the historical guidance to see it.

cases.question: What did the German label say before the September 2026 revision?
cases.answer:
Historical view: documents in effect on 2026-09-14.

The superseded German label, in effect from 03-Feb-2025 to 15-Sep-2026, stated that the historical starting dose for moderate renal impairment was 50 mg once daily [E1]. For normal and mild renal impairment, the historical starting dose was 50 mg OD, while for severe renal impairment it was not recommended [E2].

Sources
[E1] DE-AX17-LBL-038 · DE AX17 Superseded Label v3.8 · SUPERSEDED · effective 2025-02-03 · p.1–3
     https://storage.cloud.google.com/tredence-fde-1-medevidence-vks/raw/DE_AX17_Superseded_Label_v3.8.pdf#page=1
[E2] DE-AX17-LBL-038 · DE AX17 Superseded Label v3.8 · SUPERSEDED · effective 2025-02-03 · p.6, Historical renal dosing
     https://storage.cloud.google.com/tredence-fde-1-medevidence-vks/raw/DE_AX17_Superseded_Label_v3.8.pdf#page=6

Current version: DE-AX17-LBL-042 (DE AX17 Current Label v4.2), in effect since 2026-09-15. Ask for the current guidance to see it.

cases.question: What is the current renal starting dose of AX-17?
cases.answer:
For moderate renal impairment, the US recommendation is 25 mg QD; reassess (verify against the original) [E1]. For severe renal impairment, specialist assessment is recommended (verify against the original) [E1], and for dialysis there is insufficient evidence (verify against the original) [E1].

Sources
[E1] US-AX17-PI-050 · US AX17 Prescribing Information v5.0 · APPROVED · effective 2026-08-01 · p.6, US renal recommendations · VERIFY: parser text differs from the PDF
